Questions clients ask

What is GEO?

Generative Engine Optimization is the work of structuring content so AI tools, such as Google's AI Overviews, can understand it and cite it as a source. It builds on solid SEO: clear headings, direct answers to real questions and accurate page information.

How long does SEO take to show results?

It depends on the site's starting point and competition. Technical fixes and Business Profile updates can show up sooner, while ranking gains for competitive terms usually build over months. I set realistic expectations at the start and report on available data as it comes in.

What do you need to get started?

A short call about your business and goals, plus access to your WordPress site, Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4 and Google Business Profile where they apply.
